t: APOD: 2026 November 23 – The Emergence of Dark Nebula Lynds 1251

p: Discover the cosmos! Each day a different image or photograph of our fascinating universe is featured, along with a brief explanation written by a professional astronomer.

img.cap: Six panels of images, all of the same spot in the sky taken at different points in a long exposure of a faint object. The top left panel is the earliest image, taken 4 minutes into the exposure. There is a very faint wisp of dark material slightly blocking the background smattering of stars. With each successive panel, the dark wisp becomes more and more pronounced. The final image in the bottom right contains all the light collected over 20 hours. The shape and details of the dark nebula are captured in striking detail. It looks like a cloud of smoke drifting across the sky.
